title: A doni katasztrófa (The Don Catastrophe & Forced Labor (1943))
grammar: Causal Triggers, Tragedy Descriptors & Historical Memorial Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can understand and discuss The Don Catastrophe & Forced Labor (1943) in Hungary's WWII history.
I can say what happened to the Second Hungarian Army, using áldozatul esik and következtében.
I can say what happened at the River Don in January 1943.
I can use six words about the Don catastrophe, such as munkaszolgálat and hátországi gyász.
